caption: Basilica di San Martino, Martina Franca
composition: Baroque basilica and Palazzo Ducale in the white limestone centro storico · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist crosses the white limestone piazza toward the Basilica di San Martino, its twin bell towers and sculpted Baroque front rising on the right. The Palazzo Ducale fills the left with its long arcaded ground floor and rows of tall windows, with smaller whitewashed houses closing the far end. The 08:36 morning sun is already strong under a clear blue sky, throwing crisp shadows across the pale stone paving.
